reason: A DSH web plugin that integrates with the DeepSeek balance API and presents periodically refreshed account balance details in the conversation header and settings interface.

summaries.zh: 通过 DeepSeek 余额接口获取账户余额，并在 DSH Web 界面的会话标题栏和设置页中定时显示余额详情。
summaries.en: Integrates with the DeepSeek balance API to periodically display account balance details in the DSH Web conversation header and settings page.

capabilities: Reads a configured DeepSeek API credential through the host credential service
Requests account balance data from the DeepSeek balance API
Displays balance details in the DSH web interface
Polls the balance endpoint every 30 seconds
Serves balance data through a local DSH route
